title: add-prefetch-latency-matrix-and-alert-accordion
author: Maya Singh
description: Context: We've observed recurring small latency spikes during prefetch/warmup warm paths that do not trigger existing SLO alerts because they are below coarse aggregation thresholds. Motivation: Provide finer-grained visibility into prefetch-phase latency and introduce an alert 'accordion' that gracefully widens or narrows a route's alert sensitivity based on correlated signals (kv-cache hit rate, kernel-queue depth, and tenant priority). What this PR does: 1) Adds a Prefetch Latency Matrix metric pipeline (histogram shards per 50ms slab) to capture warmup latency per invocation phase and per-tenant micro-slice; 2) Adds a dashboard JSON for the matrix with cohorting controls (route, model, quantization profile, tenant tier) and interactive sparkline overlays for kernel queue and KV occupancy; 3) Implements an Alert Accordion policy in alerts/accordion_policy.go that composes multi-signal thresholds and uses a weighted dampening window (configurable) to escalate or de-escalate alert sensitivity; 4) Exposes a compact invocation log snippet sampler that attaches a short context payload when a prefetch slab crosses a threshold for easier triage; 5) Adds docs and runbook entries for interpreting matrix cohorts and for tuning accordion parameters. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated for 3 days in staging, then canary to 10% of production traffic in us-east-1, monitoring false-positive rate for 48h, then full rollout. Backwards compatibility: Metrics and API are additive; existing alerts are untouched by default. Testing: unit tests for accordion logic and e2e replay harness using synthetic warmup traces (replaybench); load test shows 2.8% p95 reduction in unnoticed prefetch spikes vs baseline while producing <0.5% additional alert volume when tuned to default thresholds. Related: ENG-2334 outlines the experimental detection logic, PM-801 tracks dashboard UX. Merge notes: squash-merge; no schema migration required.
commits: init: add prefetch latency matrix pipeline and histogram sharding (observability/metrics/prefetch_matrix.go)
feat(dashboards): add prefetch-latency-matrix dashboard JSON and cohort controls (dashboards/prefetch_latency_matrix.json)
feat(alerts): implement alert accordion policy and tests (alerts/accordion_policy.go, alerts/accordion_policy_test.go)
feat(logging): compact invocation snippet sampler and sample export (logging/snippet_sampler.go)
docs: add observability runbook and tuning guide (docs/observability/prefetch-matrix.md)
chore: feature flag wiring and rollout config (infra/flags/prefetch_matrix_flag.yaml)
review_comments: Ethan Park: This is a neat idea; can we make the accordion damping window per-tenant-configurable so platform teams can tune high-volume tenants separately?
Maya Singh: Yes, defaults are global but the policy supports per-tenant override via the tenant-config map in infra/flags/prefetch_matrix_flag.yaml. Added tests for override behavior.
Liam Chen: The histogram shard size of 50ms seems arbitrary; can you justify choice and show sensitivity?

Maya Singh: Added a short analysis in the docs showing tradeoffs; 50ms was chosen to separate warmup micro-bursts without increasing cardinality excessively. Also added a knob to switch slabs to 25/100ms in runtime config.
Sofia Morales: Concern about additional cardinality in metrics backend; what retention/cost impact?
Maya Singh: We emit rollups and keep only compact percentiles for long-term retention; initial estimate is ~3% metric volume increase, included in release notes and financial forecast.
Ethan Park: Approve after nits addressed.
release_notes: Add prefetched-phase latency matrix for fine-grained warmup visibility; introduce Alert Accordion policy for adaptive alert sensitivity; new dashboard and runbook. Default is behind feature flag. Admins can tune per-tenant thresholds.
testing_summary: Unit + integration tests added. Replaybench synthetic warmup suite used for e2e validation. Canary run for 10% traffic in us-east-1 for 48 hours; observed 2.8% better detection of warmup spikes with low extra alert noise.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag: observability.prefetch_matrix. Default disabled; enable in staging then canary. If alert volume spikes, reduce accordion aggressiveness (increase damping window) or raise composite threshold. Runbook at docs/observability/prefetch-matrix.md.
